resources.string: It walks your avatar from one Big Flower to the next with a simulated walk, writes the distance to Health Connect as steps, and takes you home whenever you like.
Open the menu → Setup, and tick each step. Nothing moves until it is done.
Long-press the map to add a Big Flower, or bring one in from the menu item \"Find nearby candidate Big Flowers\".
Press here to start the patrol, then open the game.
The floating bar and auto actions

While patrolling, the floating bar appears: ▶ pause and resume, 🏠 go home, ■ stop, 🚶 travel mode, speed, 🎮 joystick, ◎ scan for Big Flowers, 🤖 auto actions, 📍 real location switch. Drag the handle to move it. 🤖 sends fruit and seedling expeditions from the game\'s expedition list, or feeds nectar on the feed screen. Stop it from the notification.
